resources.string: This is Lumora\'s guided setup. Every row shows one capability and its state; press Fix when something is not ready yet. Repairs that need a computer over ADB stay in the ADB tools section, so nothing here can break your device.
Automatic update check switched to daily.
Fire OS is not opening Lumora as the home screen right now. Run this once from a computer connected over ADB:

Lumora needs WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS so quick actions and the Home button redirect work (Fire OS hides those switches for apps outside the Appstore). Run this once from a computer, then press Fix again:
Fire OS must allow Lumora to install apps. Turn on Lumora under Settings › My Fire TV › Developer options › Install unknown apps, or run this once from a computer:
Everything here can also be repaired by hand: the ADB tools section lists the exact commands, including the ones that can only run from a computer.
%1$s of cache freed. Everything is refetched to taste later.
Press Run checks to test every service the launcher talks to.
Beta offers pre-release builds as soon as CI publishes them; stable waits for the release marked latest. Both channels verify the same signature.
Send a link from the phone
Send a file from the phone
Works while these settings are open. Scan the QR code, then paste a link or pick a file on the phone. Files up to 512 MB land in the TV\'s Downloads folder; APK files are saved, never installed.
Scan the code with the phone camera, paste an http or https link on the page and tap Open. The TV opens it in its browser; the link is not logged.
No browser is available on this TV. Open the link on any device:
Scan the code with the phone camera, pick a file on the page and tap Send. The file is streamed straight into the TV\'s Downloads folder. APK files are saved, never installed.
